reasons: Claimed status is compliant and no redline/comment is expected; the rendered redline correctly leaves p0077–p0081 unchanged.

Cited text supports compliance with the preferred position: § 19.1 (professional and workmanlike, qualified personnel, industry standards, material conformance to documentation/specs), § 19.2 (ninety days from delivery or acceptance, whichever is later, for Deliverables; Hosted Services conform throughout the subscription term, meeting or exceeding the 12-month software benchmark), § 19.3 (Applicable Law compliance, no malicious code), § 19.4 (re-perform/repair/replace escalating to termination and refund of Fees).
The disclaimer element is satisfied: § 19.5 is limited to implied warranties and expressly states no disclaimer limits an express warranty or stated remedy, so no carve-out edit is needed.
The failed deterministic check is a phrasing artifact only — the period is spelled out as "ninety days" rather than in digits — and does not indicate a substantive shortfall.

Minor residual points are correctly treated as not worth negotiating capital at medium severity: malicious code limited to code "intentionally introduced by Vendor," and the refund remedy keyed to "Fees" (defined in § 1.5 as the Implementation Fee), which could be worth a definitional note if raised elsewhere but does not defeat the compliant classification.
